---
title: Combining results from Prioritizations
---

```{r}
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scico)
library(stringr)
```

## Read in data

Base hexes (currie paper)
```{r}
# Some hexes are duplicatde, so we slice head for each scenario below
hexes <- read_sf("analyses/currie/Hexbins_100km_EA_ED.shp") |> 
    group_by(OBJECTID_1)|>
    slice_head(n = 1)
# ggplot(hexes[duplicated(hexes$OBJECTID_1),]) + geom_sf()
# st_write(hexes[duplicated(hexes$OBJECTID_1),], "analyses/currie/results/hexes_dup.shp")
```

Currie results
```{r}
# All scenarios
# Choice: only taking solution 1
currie_20 <- read_sf("analyses/currie/results/pu_100km_target20_5sol.shp") |> 
    mutate(target = "t_20") |>
    group_by(OBJECTID_1)|>
    slice_head(n = 1)
currie_30 <- read_sf("analyses/currie/results/pu_100km_target30_5sol.shp") |> 
    mutate(target = "t_30") |>
    group_by(OBJECTID_1)|>
    slice_head(n = 1)
currie_40 <- read_sf("analyses/currie/results/pu_100km_target40_5sol.shp") |> 
    mutate(target = "t_40") |>
    group_by(OBJECTID_1)|>
    slice_head(n = 1)
currie_50 <- read_sf("analyses/currie/results/pu_100km_target50_5sol.shp") |> 
    mutate(target = "t_50")  |>
    group_by(OBJECTID_1)|>
    slice_head(n = 1)

currie_all <- bind_rows(currie_20, currie_30, currie_40, currie_50) |>
    # mutate(sol_sum = solution_1 + solution_2 + solution_3 + solution_4 + solution_5) |>
    select(OBJECTID_1, GRID_ID, solution_5, target, geometry)

# Only 1s
currie_all_filt <- currie_all |> 
    # mutate(sol_sum_bin = sol_sum > 0) |>
    # filter(sol_sum_bin != 0) |>
    # select(-sol_sum)
    filter(solution_5 == 1)

# Summarize all scenarios
currie_all_filt_sum <- currie_all_filt |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = target, 
                values_from = solution_5, values_fill = 0) |>
    mutate(priority = t_20 + t_30 + t_40 + t_50) |>
    select(-starts_with("t_"))

ggplot(currie_all_filt_sum) + geom_sf(aes(fill = priority), color = NA) + 
    scale_fill_scico(palette = "vik")

currie_list <- list(currie_20 = currie_20, 
                    currie_30 = currie_30, 
                    currie_40 = currie_40, 
                    currie_50 = currie_50)

# Write out figures
for (sce_name in names(currie_list)) {
    sce <- currie_list[[sce_name]]
    for (sol in 1:5) {
        plot_name <- paste0(sce_name, "_sol_", sol)
        sol_var <- paste0("solution_", sol)
        p <- ggplot(sce |> filter(.data[[sol_var]] > 0)) + 
            geom_sf(aes(fill = .data[[sol_var]]), color = NA) +
            ggtitle(plot_name) +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(legend.position = "none")
        ggsave(paste0("analyses/currie/results/", plot_name, ".png"), p)
    }
}

# Let's assume that what we want is currie 30, solution #1
currie_final <- currie_30 |> filter(solution_1 > 0)
st_write(currie_final, "results/currie_final.shp", delete_dsn = T)
```

Eckert results
```{r}
# Load all scenarios
eckert_sce_list <- list.files("analyses/eckert/21732722/Rank Maps/Binary Run Maps/", 
                              pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = T)
eckert_all_rast <- rast(eckert_sce_list)
main_rast <- eckert_all_rast["MASTER"]

hexes_eckert <- hexes |> 
    select(OBJECTID_1, GRID_ID) |>
    st_transform(st_crs(main_rast))

plot(main_rast)
main_rast[is.na(main_rast)] <- 0
main_rast[main_rast != 0] <- 1
plot(main_rast)
# terra::writeRaster(main_rast, "results/eckert_master_bin.tiff", overwrite = T)

# turn to same 100km grid for comparison
modal_fun <- function(x) {
  x <- na.omit(x)
  ux <- unique(x)
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}
extracted <- terra::extract(main_rast, hexes_eckert, fun = modal_fun)
eckert_final <- hexes_eckert |> 
    bind_cols(extracted) |>
    filter(MASTER == 1) |>
    st_transform(st_crs(hexes))

ggplot(eckert_final) + 
    geom_sf(aes(fill = MASTER), color = NA) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

st_write(eckert_final, "results/eckert_final.shp", delete_dsn = T)
```


Karimi results
```{r}
karimi_sce_list <- c(
    list.files("analyses/karimi/3-final_result/without_Indigenous_Lands/", 
               pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = T),
    list.files("analyses/karimi/3-final_result/with_Indigenous_lands/", 
               pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = T)
)
karimi_sce_list <- karimi_sce_list[!str_detect(karimi_sce_list, "[Pp]enalty")]

karimi_all_rast <- rast(karimi_sce_list)

karimi_rast <- karimi_all_rast["NotIn_S11_HFCost_Lokedin_30Percent_Target"]
hexes_karimi <- hexes |> 
    select(OBJECTID_1, GRID_ID) |>
    st_transform(st_crs(karimi_rast))

plot(karimi_rast)
karimi_rast[is.na(karimi_rast)] <- 0
karimi_rast[karimi_rast != 0] <- 1
plot(karimi_rast)

extracted_karimi <- terra::extract(karimi_rast, hexes_karimi, fun = modal_fun)
karimi_final <- hexes_karimi |> 
    bind_cols(extracted_karimi) |>
    filter(NotIn_S11_HFCost_Lokedin_30Percent_Target == 1) |>
    st_transform(st_crs(hexes))

ggplot(karimi_final) + 
    geom_sf(aes(fill = NotIn_S11_HFCost_Lokedin_30Percent_Target), color = NA) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

st_write(karimi_final, "results/karimi_final.shp", delete_dsn = T)
```

## Rasterizing currie

```{r}
currie_final <- st_read("results/currie_final.shp")
base_rast <- rast("analyses/eckert/21732722/Rank Maps/Binary Run Maps/MASTER.tif") |> 
    project (currie_final, method = "mode")
writeRaster(base_rast, "results/eckert_rast_reproj.tiff")
currie_final_rasterized <- rasterize(currie_final, base_rast)
writeRaster(currie_final_rasterized, "results/currie_final_rast.tiff")
```

## Comparisons

Vector based 

```{r}
cur <- st_read("results/currie_final.shp") |> 
    select(OBJECTID_1, GRID_ID, cur = solution_1) 
eck <- st_read("results/eckert_final.shp") |> 
    select(OBJECTID_1, GRID_ID, eck = MASTER)
kar <- st_read("results/karimi_final.shp") |> 
    select(OBJECTID_1 = OBJECTI, GRID_ID, kar = NI_S11_)

all <- st_drop_geometry(cur)|> 
    full_join(st_drop_geometry(eck)) |>
    full_join(st_drop_geometry(kar)) |>
    full_join(select(hexes, OBJECTID_1, GRID_ID)) |>
    st_as_sf() |>
    mutate(cur = ifelse(is.na(cur), 0, cur)) |>
    mutate(eck = ifelse(is.na(eck), 0, eck)) |>
    mutate(kar = ifelse(is.na(kar), 0, kar)) |>
    mutate(agreement = cur + eck + kar)|>
    filter(agreement >= 1)

ggplot(all) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = agreement), color = NA) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none") + 
    scale_fill_scico(palette = "vik")
```

## AI GEN 

```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(units)
# Set size of smaller hexagons (in map units, e.g., meters or degrees)
hex_size <- 1000  # example: 1000 meters

# Create bounding box over large hexes
bbox <- st_bbox(hexes_simple)

# Generate smaller hex grid over the bounding box
small_hex_grid <- st_make_grid(
  hexes_simple,
  cellsize = hex_size,
  square = FALSE  # ensures hexagons
) %>%
  st_sf()
# Perform spatial join to clip small hexes within large ones
# This assigns an ID to each large hexagon
hexes_simple <- hexes_simple %>%
  mutate(hex_id = row_number())

# Spatial join: assign each small hex to the large hex it falls into
small_in_large <- st_join(small_hex_grid, hexes_simple, join = st_intersects)

# Optionally remove NAs (those small hexes not within any large hex)
small_in_large <- small_in_large %>% filter(!is.na(hex_id))
library(ggplot2)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = hexes_simple, fill = NA, color = "black") +
  geom_sf(data = small_in_large, aes(fill = as.factor(hex_id)), color = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none")

```
